label: review-audit
command:
import json, re, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import unquote
root = Path.cwd()
evidence = root / "docs/validation/2026-10-23-graph-failures"
expected = {
    "backend/src/incident_copilot/agents/tool_loop.py",
    "backend/tests/unit/agents/test_tool_loop.py",
    "backend/tests/unit/llm/test_openai_provider.py",
}
changed = set(subprocess.check_output(["git", "diff", "--name-only", "HEAD"], text=True).splitlines())
assert changed == expected, changed
untracked = subprocess.check_output(["git", "ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard"], text=True).splitlines()
assert all(name == "backend/tests/unit/agents/test_execution.py" or name.startswith(str(evidence.relative_to(root)) + "/") for name in untracked), untracked
subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--check"], check=True)
assert not subprocess.check_output(["git", "ls-files", ".env", "REFACTORING_PLAN.md"], text=True).strip()
ignored = subprocess.check_output(["git", "check-ignore", ".env", "REFACTORING_PLAN.md"], text=True).splitlines()
assert set(ignored) == {".env", "REFACTORING_PLAN.md"}
links = 0
for target in re.findall(r"\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)", (evidence / "README.md").read_text()):
    if "://" not in target:
        assert (evidence / unquote(target.split("#")[0])).resolve().exists(), target
        links += 1
patterns = [r"sk-(?:proj-)?[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}", r"-----BEGIN (?:RSA |EC |OPENSSH )?PRIVATE KEY-----", r"AKIA[A-Z0-9]{16}"]
files = [root / name for name in changed | set(untracked) if (root / name).is_file()]
for path in files:
    contents = path.read_text()
    assert not any(re.search(pattern, contents) for pattern in patterns), str(path.relative_to(root))
records = [json.loads(line) for line in (evidence / "checks.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
assert len({record["label"] for record in records}) == len(records)
for record in records:
    assert record["environment_keys"] == ["PATH"]
    assert (evidence / (record["label"] + ".log")).is_file(), record["label"]
print(f"PASS: scoped diff, {links} local links, private-file ignores, {len(files)} files scanned for credential patterns, {len(records)} unique retained check records.")
